title: Pip and the Sleepy Sunflower Seed
moral: Good things grow when we wait patiently and keep caring.
description: Pip the little fox gets a tiny sunflower seed from Nana Hoot and wants it to grow RIGHT NOW! With help from his best friend Tumble, a rainy day and a lot of waiting, Pip discovers what happens when you give something time to grow. A gentle animated story about patience for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess what, friends? One sunny morning, Pip the little fox skipped over to Nana Hoot's garden.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Good morning, Pip! I have a present for you. It's a sunflower seed!
The seed was tiny. It was stripy. It was even smaller than Pip's nose!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: A sunflower? Will it grow as tall as Tumble?

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Even taller! But first we plant it... and then we wait.

narration.text: Pip dug a little hole, popped the seed inside, and patted the soil. Pat, pat, pat!
Then Pip sat and stared at the ground. And stared. And stared some more.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Grow, seed, grow! Hurry up, please!
But nothing happened. Not even a teeny-tiny wiggle.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Hi, Pip! I brought the watering can. Seeds get thirsty, you know.

narration.text: By lunchtime, Pip had a big idea. Uh-oh!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Maybe the seed is stuck! I'll dig it up and take a peek.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Wait, little one. A seed likes to stay snug in the soil. It grows one tiny bit at a time.
So Pip put down the spade and took a big, slow breath. In... and out.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Okay, Nana. I'll try to be patient.
That night, the moon came up and the fireflies came out. Twinkle, twinkle!
Pip tiptoed out to the garden for one last look.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Goodnight, little seed. Sleep tight, and grow just a tiny bit, okay?
Can you whisper goodnight to the seed too? Goodnight, seed!

narration.text: Day after day, Pip waited. But waiting is much easier with a friend!
Pip and Tumble made little leaf boats and sailed them down the stream. Whoosh!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: My boat is winning! Oh, wait... now yours is!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Hee hee! Waiting is more fun when we play together.

narration.text: When the summer sun went down, the sunflower glowed like a golden lamp.
Its big, round face was full of brand-new seeds. Hundreds of them!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Let's save these seeds and plant a whole sunflower garden next spring!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Good things take time, Pip. And you waited beautifully.
And now Pip didn't mind waiting one bit. Not even a teeny-tiny bit!
